dataList.content:
There was wilting among the nine.
九人之中，一片凋零。
dataList.place:
Withering League of Nine Littérateurs
逐渐枯萎的九人会

dataList.content:
Those who indulged in research with purity and astonishment on their faces as they did in the old days have already withdrawn their buds.
过去满脸纯粹和惊叹而进行研究的他们，已然收拢了花蕾。

In exchange, unfamiliar sounds began to fill the air.
取而代之的是，陌生的声音。

Orderly footsteps, sounds of wind-up keys that signify their position, and heavy, low voices.
整齐的脚步声，象征着他们身份的发条声，沉重而低沉的话语声。

Why... Why did you tell them the League's location, Aneung?
为什么……九人会的位置被发现了，雅能？

...Anyone would have done the same.
……任何人都会做出同样的选择。

They said if I don't reveal the source of the technology... I'll be forcefully repatriated to S Corp.
他们说如果我不说出技术的来源……就会被遣返回S公司。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Then you should've braced for it! Have the guts to bite your tongue and die if you couldn't stand to survive alone in the hometown!
那你就该滚回家乡，独自咬舌自尽吧！

W-Why are these people dragging me away?
这、这些人为何要将我带走？

Why is it a crime that I couldn't yield my technology?
为何不让出自己的技术成了罪过？

My technology was worthless! You said it yourself, Young-ji! Help! I don't want to go!
我的技术没有价值！这不是你说的吗，灵之！救救我！我不想被带走！

No matter how hard we think... There's really only one way.
无论我们怎么想……办法都仅有一种。

It'll all be over once I go back. If I give away the glass...
我回去的话，一切就都结束了。但如果我交出玻璃……

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
If you're caught, the League will be done for. Who knows what might they do with your technology once it falls into their hands?
如果你被捕，我们九人会就全完了。如果玻璃技术落入他们手中，天知道他们会拿它来干什么？

The voices of desperation ringing in the air did not change a thing.
环绕在空气中的绝望之声，什么也改变不了。

And so, there were those who rejected the notion of yielding their creations...
然后，便是那些拒绝交出技术的人……

I knew my turn would come.
我知道轮到我了。

And... I don't believe we'll ever see each other again.
还有……我不认为我们会再会了。

Those who calmly let themselves be taken away...
那些被平静带走的人……

I'm bored of living in hiding.
我已经厌倦这种躲躲藏藏的生活了。

I've decided to go my own way. Let's hope we never meet again.
我要走自己的路。希望我们再也不会。

Those who left on their own...
那些按自己意愿离开的人……

I saw a child who resembled the ocean.
我遇到了一个海一般的孩子。

It's not like the glass... or the mirror, but I like the things reflected on the waves and tides of the ocean.
它与玻璃……或是镜子都不一样，但我喜欢那些在海洋的潮汐和波浪中反射出来的东西。

Since I couldn't fathom the depth of the waters, I decided to follow along.
我不知道水有多深，于是我便决定追随它。

And those who forever disappeared, leaving unknowable parting remarks.
还有那些仅留些许意义不明之语，永远消失的人。

Like that... winter approached.
就像这样……严冬已至。

That was a painful experience. It was like I was actually in the shoes of a League of Nine member...
真是痛苦的经历。就好像我真的是九人会的一员一样……

We're synchronizing with their memories. It's only natural that their traces will influence us.
我们在与他们的记忆同步，当然会被他们的痕迹影响。
